utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the exact details for the repair drive first? I want to make sure I get it right before I do anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sure — the repair drive starts Saturday morning at the community shed, and everything should go there. If you want, I can send the exact drop-off list too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mina — please send the exact drop-off list, and I’ll make sure I follow it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Dane — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — did I miss anything important about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: No worries — you didn’t miss much. I just asked what you’d like me to bring or do for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I could use help spreading the repair drive details around and pointing out the basics to anyone who missed them.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, the repair drive is still happening, right? I can help spread the details if that’s the case.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, it’s still happening — thanks, Kira. I’ll keep repeating the basics and let folks who missed it know.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what do we need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Jules — I think we need to confirm the start time and whether it overlaps with school pickup. It’s now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday at the porch.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it — I’ll help confirm the start time and check the school pickup overlap right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — send me the fixes and supplies list, and I’ll keep track of it for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure — the repair drive is Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send over the fixes plus the small list of tools and patch kits.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I’ve got Sunday at the community center noted. Send the fixes and tool list whenever you’re ready, and I’ll keep track of it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yep, the repair drive is still on. I’m a little fuzzy on the exact details, but we can sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Just send me the time and place, and I’ll make sure everyone hears it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still checking the time and place, but I’ll send them as soon as I’ve got them. Appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Leo. I’ll stick to the plan and check back later for any pickup updates on the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — check back later and let me know if any pickups change.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Leo — I’ll check back later and keep an ear out for any pickup changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve been hearing the repair drive is getting a good turnout already. If you want, I can keep an eye out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — could you tell me the exact timing and drop-off spot? I just want to make sure I plan the haul properly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, for sure — I’ll pass along the exact timing and drop-off spot as soon as I hear it. I’m keeping an ear out for the details now.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, just point me to what still needs fixing when I’m over. I’ll catch up on the rest there.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I’ll show you the worst spots when you get here, and we can start there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — I’ll look for the worst spots first and we can go from there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I appreciate it. See you at the hall, and let me know if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll head to the hall and start sorting the tools. If anything comes up, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rey — I’ll see you at the hall. Appreciate you helping get everything sorted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I still haven’t heard any new repair drive updates, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Ira — if you hear anything, could you let me know? I’m still piecing it together from updates.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know right away if I hear anything while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Gus — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center. I’m ready to note the needed fixes and who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Rosa — I’ll bring my tool kit and some screws, and I’ll spread the word about Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Gus — that’ll be a big help. I’ll keep track of your tool kit and screws, and I appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It starts at 2:00 PM on Sunday, so it shouldn’t conflict with school pickup. Thanks for checking, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, 2:00 PM works for me. I’ll let the other parents know the Sunday community center location and ask who can bring tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Faye — thank you. I’ll keep track of tools and supplies, and we’ll meet Sunday at 2:00 PM at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Nope, you’re good — Vik said he’ll point things out and repeat the repair drive details. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks — just wanted to know what spots need attention. Mostly the cracked edge near the curb and that loose patch by the gate, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, that’s right — the cracked edge by the curb and the loose patch by the gate. I’ll keep an eye out for anything else too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — the repair drive. I’m happy to help; just point me to what needs fixing and I’ll do my best.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Oren. Bring by whatever’s still on the list, and we’ll sort out the next fixes together.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, Uli — thanks for checking the tools and getting the sign-up list ready. See you by the garage Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Sure, Gus — I’ll have everything ready by Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, thanks, Uli — I’ll bring the extra wrench and drill by the garage Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning at the community shed still works for me — could you tell me the exact start time so I can plan around it?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll check the exact start time and get back to you. For now, Saturday morning at the community shed is still the plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I just need the exact start time when you have it so I can plan the morning properly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We still need hands for setup and a quick check on tools and supplies. If you can keep an eye out for gaps, that’d help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can do that. Send me the tools and supplies list, and I’ll note any gaps for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Opal. I’ll send the list over now so you can flag any gaps.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Quinn — I’m still catching up, so if you can give me the basics, I’ll help spread the word to anyone who missed it.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m sending the time and place now so you can pass it along to anyone who missed it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — send me the time and place, and I’ll pass it along to anyone who missed it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira — it’s now Sunday at the community center. I’m keeping track of supplies, so let me know what you need brought over.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Cleo — I haven’t heard any new repair drive updates yet, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks, Ira — I’ll do the same and keep an eye on supplies for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Have we set the repair drive date yet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Not yet, but I’m happy to help lock it in—what dates work best for everyone?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Saturday morning works for me. Can we lock it in for the community shed?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Hana — I’ve got you on the list. See you at the hall, and I really appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Mara — before I head over, could you share the exact repair drive details again so I’m sure I have them right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — we’re meeting at the community hall, and I’m hoping folks can help sort the tools and keep an ear out for any repair updates. Thanks again for pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve been hearing the repair drive is getting a nice turnout already. If you want, I can keep an eye out for what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Tess—that’d be great. If you hear what they still need, let me know and I’ll help out.
